_comment: Sites that still spell the zero-default sentinel as `> 0`, keyed on the file
and the tested expression so a line move does not invalidate a record.
This is a ratchet, not a blessing. A site that is neither converted nor
listed here is a new one. A record is deleted in the change that converts
its site -- the scan fails on a record that matches nothing.
`measured` says whether the core's response to a negative or non-finite
request was actually driven. `no` means the site's disposition is unknown,
which is the narrowing step this population still needs: a filter is only a
defect where the core would have refused the value it swallowed.
The floor is a liveness check on the scan, not a target. Converting sites
past it means lowering it deliberately in the same change.
